page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include any bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Additionally, the underlying CPU lacks support for advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography like AES or SHA_NI.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers a predictable resource profile for entry-level workloads. It is configured for general purpose tasks that do not rely on heavy vector mathematics, cryptographic acceleration, or local high-speed storage. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, and small-scale development environments.
